protocol.method: Registry reconciliation against the executable pin, not a new A/B run.
protocol.history: 2026-07-11-role-routing assigned gpt-5.6-luna:medium for mechanical work; commit ba68621 (chore(synthesis): repin commit message writer model) deliberately repinned the droid to glm-5.2:high afterward, and the registry was never updated.
protocol.artifactPolicy: No transcripts; the evidence is repository history.

decision.rationale: Droid frontmatter is the source of truth because it is what executes. The registry and README are synchronized to it, and scripts/validate.mjs section 8 now fails CI on any future divergence.

limitations: The repin commit recorded no comparative measurements; the assignment stays provisional.
Promotion to validated requires golden-task 20 (commit-message-writer) baseline runs comparing glm-5.2:high against gpt-5.6-luna:medium under evals/policy.json repetition rules.
